overview: This Senate resolution sets which senators from the majority party sit on four Senate committees: Appropriations, which writes spending bills; Environment and Public Works; the Judiciary; and the Budget. It lists the members and chair of each, including a senator listed as Ms. Graham on all four. Resolutions like this are routine and are used to fill committee seats when membership changes. The Senate agreed to it by unanimous consent on July 21, 2026.
for: Supporters say it is a routine step that keeps committees fully staffed so they can continue their work.
against: Critics say there is little to object to, since it is an internal housekeeping measure that does not change any law or spending.
